card.name: Words leading into outcome or time phrases
card.fires_on: Short connecting words such as level, in, resolved, treatment or months, where the next words give a dose level, a percentage or a time span. Mostly in label sections on adverse reactions and dose changes.

modes.label: Resolution of reactions
modes.description: Words like resolved, in or resolution just before a percentage or number of days.

modes.label: Dose-reduction wording
modes.description: The word level after next lower dose, before a condition for resuming.
modes.example: Consider resuming FRUZAQLA at the next lower dose<< level>> only if the toxicity is non-life threatening

modes.label: Treatment of a reaction
modes.description: The word treatment, or part of a drug-class word, in a phrase about managing a reaction.
modes.example: Remove the catheter as soon as possible and initiate appropriate medical<< treatment>> if thromb
